text: sofia's dad passed away sat night. funeral is thurs 14/11 at st marks, she said family flowers only so dont send any. text her fri

luis got made redundant today, whole dept gone, about 40 ppl. he seemed weirdly ok about it, says he'd been wanting out for ages and might finally do the electrician course. but his wife Noor is v worried w/ the baby coming in march and her mat pay being rubbish. he's got a mtg w/ hr next tuesday about the package. ask him how that goes
reggie knee op moved to next tuesday. hes on crutches for 6 wks after so no 5 a side till new yr
need to drop a card round to Fatima b4 the weekend, her nan died last wk
dawit and julia split up. been coming a while apparently. he's staying at his brother Thomas's for now
noah has his scan results appt 3rd of june, he's trying not to think about it. remind me to ring him that evening
mtg w/ hassan re the redundancy consultation moved to 14 may

anders mum is in hospital again, fell on the stairs fri and broke her hip. op was yesterday, went ok. he's driving up and down to leeds every day and looks shattered. ask him if he wants me to cover his shifts next wk
eduardo - lactose intolerant, and hates mushrooms. bday 9th of feb
dentist appt tmrw 9.15 dont forget

nikolai's uncle died in kyiv. he's flying out sun for the funeral and back the following weds hopefully, depends on trains from the border. his uncle basically raised him after his dad left so its a big one. didnt want a fuss at work, just asked me to keep an eye on his plants and tell Anders he's off
jack got the all clear!! 2 yrs after the chemo. must take him for a pint this wk
owen and gemma's wedding is off. not saying more than that. he's moved out, she's keeping the flat in hove
damian having his gallbladder out on 22/11. day surgery but he's dreading it, hates needles. his partner Karan will pick him up after
pooja was let go fri, no warning, told in a 10 min call. she's applying for stuff already but v knocked. i should send her the job at my place
isaac's dog Biscuit had to be put down mon. he's gutted, had her 14 yrs

lola starts chemo next thurs. she says the first round is the worst and her sister Mai is coming down from glasgow to stay w/ her for a fortnight. lola wants normal chat not cancer chat, keep that in mind
mariam's grandad funeral was today. check in w/ her tmrw
nia mentioned she's been on the waiting list for her hip for over a yr. finally got a date, 6 december
hugo broke up w/ rin. rin is apparently fine, hugo is not lol. both coming to the bday drinks sat so that'll be fun
gemma's dad has his heart bypass on 2nd of march. she's flying back from lisbon the day before. dont forget to message her on the day
karan into hospital tonight w/ appendicitis, op probs tmrw morning. his mum is with him
noor's waters broke?? no wait thats next month. due 19/03. she's off work from feb

called georgia about francesca. francesca had a mini stroke last tues, still in st thomas's, georgia says she's talking ok but tired. georgia is visiting every day after work and is running on empty. her boss has been rubbish about it. i should offer to do a hospital run sat so she gets a break. and francesca loves crosswords, take her the saturday guardian
pick up mum's prescription fri
bjorn - his dad died in the summer, he mentioned it was 6 months on the 3rd of jan. maybe text him that day
alessia had her tonsils out mon. sounds grim, on ice lollies only. back at work next monday apparently
sofia's mum (rosa?) is moving in w/ her after the funeral. she's not sure how its gonna go
reggie - op went fine, home tmrw. his daughter is doing the school runs this wk
thomas lost his job at the bank. third round of cuts. he's got an interview thurs at a fintech place in shoreditch, sounded nervous. text him good luck weds night
taking Dawit to his mri on monday at 8, then work. he can't drive after
julia moving out of the flat she shared w/ dawit end of month. needs boxes, i've got loads in the loft
fatima's brother Hassan has been off sick for 3 wks with long covid. she's really worried about him, he lives alone
funeral for Mrs Novak next fri 11am at the crem. wear dark. eduardo and his wife will be there too, maybe go for a coffee w/ them after
owen v low after the break up. said he's not sleeping, barely eating. i need to get him out the house this weekend, maybe a walk on the downs
mai's cat Pickle went missing tues. posters up on her road. ask her tmrw if he's turned up
luis's last day at the firm is friday 31st. leaving drinks at the crown 6pm. thinking of chipping in for something, he's into fancy coffee so maybe a grinder
noah - results back. benign. huge relief. send him something nice
anders' mum home from hospital today. he says she's grumpy but on the mend
cancelled lunch w/ isaac on weds, he's got a hospital appt that clashed. rebook for next wk
karan had his op, all good. hassan and i are going to see him sun. bring grapes obvs

hugo's grandma died weds night. he was v close to her, used to go every sunday for lunch. funeral not sorted yet, probs the week after next, depends on the vicar. he said his mum is taking it hardest, she was the one caring for her. he sounded flat but kept saying he's fine. i should drop round w/ food sat, he wont cook
nikolai - back from kyiv. didnt ask much, he wasn't up for talking. message him in a few days just to see how he's doing
dr shah said physio twice a wk for 6 wks, starting 4 nov. booked the first one
pooja got a second interview on 28/10!! she's nervous but its the one she really wants
damian's sister Lola is having a baby in april, he's going to be an uncle for the first time. v excited
rin started cbt last wk for anxiety, she says it's helping a bit
francesca being discharged tmrw hopefully. georgia's sorting the stairlift. francesca hates fuss so keep the visit short. remind me to call georgia sunday to see how the first few days went
gemma - dad's op done, in icu for 2 days, now on the ward. she's staying till the 14th. she sounded exhausted but relieved
jack and his wife celebrating 10 yrs on the 3rd of june, he wants to do something surprise. she's always going on about that place in whitstable
mariam's son Owen got into the ucl course he wanted, starts sept. she's over the moon
alessia's mum had a stroke this morning. she's on the way to the hospital in brighton now, i said i'll feed the cat (Sasha) tonight and tmrw

eduardo has been made redundant from the council after 15 yrs. 3 months notice so finishes 20 jan. he wants to go freelance doing planning consultancy, already has a couple of clients lined up and his wife Sofia is back full time from nov so they'll manage. he asked if i know any accountants, put him in touch w/ Damian
need to sort the car mot b4 the 15th
sofia said the inquest is set for 7/12. she's dreading it, her brother Luis is going with her. text her the night before
the trip to porto w/ georgia and nia on 14 may is off, nia's surgery got moved to that wk. nia's gutted. might do a weekend in june instead
björn into hospital next weds for his shoulder, keyhole. off work for a month. his wife Julia said he's being a nightmare patient already ha

mai - had a long call. her dad's dementia has got a lot worse since the summer and they're looking at care homes, first viewing is next thursday. her brother Isaac lives in dubai so it's all on her and she's barely sleeping. she also mentioned her own back's playing up again, physio on the 4th. need to check in w/ her after the viewing, and maybe send some of those posh biscuits she likes

georgia's partner Damian was in a&e last night w/ chest pains. turned out to be a panic attack not his heart, but they're keeping an eye on him and he's got a cardiology appt on 12 dec just in case. georgia said he's been under loads of pressure since the restructure at work and there's talk of more redundancies in jan. he doesn't want people knowing. she's going to make him take a few days off this wk
quiet one. nothing much, just a catch up w/ Noah about football
